layout_note: Use the real ASE 2025 Valg artifact through dataset_candidate/valg/. It contains the 64-project list, SHA revision lists, JavaMOP/TraceMOP jars, experiment scripts, and result CSVs from the paper.
copy_note: The shared package is read-only. For scripts that write outputs or clone subjects, copy scripts/ and experiments/ into project/ and run from that writable copy.

instance_layout.note: Subject GitHub repositories are not vendored; clone them at pinned SHAs during experiments.

java_environment.note: Prepared automatically by container_setup.sh to match the official Valg Dockerfile (OpenJDK 8, Maven 3.8.8, AspectJ 1.9.7).

python_environment.note: The virtual environment is prepared automatically at container startup with pandas/optuna/sklearn and related deps; do not recreate a host .venv inside the shared mount.

not_provided.subject_checkouts: Only project names + SHAs are packaged; clone GitHub subjects at runtime and document which ones ran.
not_provided.full_trace_archives: Collected execution traces are generated by scripts/collect_traces.sh and are not pre-bundled.
